nodeGroups.name: Plan sync window
nodeGroups.description: Starts from the day of the last stored sample (or 7 days back, max 14 days) up to now, one request per metric

nodeGroups.name: Pull health data
nodeGroups.description: Reads daily activity, heart rate, resting HR, HRV, weight, sleep stages and workouts, then turns them into rows

nodeGroups.name: Store fresh samples
nodeGroups.description: Replaces partial rows from earlier syncs in the same window, so each day ends with its final values
